payout_quote: Promo code Q3DIG26 MUST be used when opening a U.S. Bank Business Essentials or Platinum Business Checking account. Limit of one bonus per business. To earn a business checking bonus, open a qualifying U.S. Bank business checking account between 7/01/2026 and 9/27/2026. Make the required deposit(s) in new money within 30 days of account opening, maintain the same required daily balance through the 60th day, and complete 6 qualifying transactions based on posted date within 60 days of account opening. Business Essentials: $400 bonus with $5,000 deposits and daily balance. Platinum Business Checking: $1,200 bonus with $25,000 deposits and daily balance. New money is defined as funds from outside U.S. Bank. Bonus will be deposited into your new eligible U.S. Bank business checking account within 30 days after the month-end in which all offer requirements are met, provided the account remains open with a positive available balance. Existing businesses with a business checking account or had one closed within the past 12 months, do not qualify.
steps: Confirm your business has no U.S. Bank business checking account and has not closed one in the past 12 months.
Open a new U.S. Bank Business Essentials or Platinum Business Checking account between 7/1/2026 and 9/27/2026 using promo code Q3DIG26 ($25 minimum deposit).
Deposit the required new money within 30 days: $5,000+ for Business Essentials ($400 bonus) or $25,000+ for Platinum ($1,200 bonus).
Maintain the required daily balance through the 60th day and complete 6 qualifying transactions within 60 days.
Receive the bonus within 30 days after the month-end in which all requirements are met.
catches: OFFER EXPIRES SEPTEMBER 27, 2026 - 5 days from verification.
Business customers only - requires a business entity; not available to individuals.
Large new-money deposits required: $5,000 for $400 tier, $25,000 for $1,200 tier.
New money only - cannot transfer from another U.S. Bank product or affiliate.
Not eligible if your business has a U.S. Bank business checking account or closed one within the past 12 months.
Must maintain the full required daily balance through the 60th day - a single dip can disqualify you.
6 qualifying transactions required (debit purchases, ACH/wire, Zelle, mobile check deposit, bill pay); P2P, credit card transfers, and internal U.S. Bank transfers do not count.
Limit one bonus per business; cannot combine with other business checking bonus offers.
Platinum account has a $30 monthly maintenance fee unless waived ($25,000 average collected balance or other waivers).
biggest_catch: EXPIRES 9/27/2026. Business-only, and the $1,200 tier requires parking $25,000 in new money for 60 days with no balance dips.
